chunks: And among them is what Abu Talib al-Qummi narrated, saying:

I entered upon Abu Ja'far al-Thani (peace be upon him) in the last period of his life, and I heard him say: May Allah reward Safwan ibn Yahya, and Muhammad ibn Sinan, and Zakariyya ibn Adam, and Sa'd ibn Sa'd, on my behalf with good; for they have fulfilled their covenant [of Wilayah] for me, and Zakariyya ibn Adam was among those who had his Wilayah.

key_terms.زَكَرِيَّا بْنَ آدَمَ: Zakariyya ibn Adam, one of the Four Emissaries
key_terms.سَعْدَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ: Sa'd ibn Sa'd, one of the Four Emissaries
key_terms.صَفْوَانَ بْنَ يَحْيَى: Safwan ibn Yahya, one of the Four Emissaries
key_terms.مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سِنَانٍ: Muhammad ibn Sinan, one of the Four Emissaries

ai.seo_question: Who were the four emissaries praised by Imam al-Sadiq for fulfilling their covenant of Wilayah?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the critical role of the 'Four Emissaries' (al-Nuwwab al-Arba'a) during the Minor Occultation, serving as the primary link between the hidden Imam and the broader Shia community. By specifically praising Safwan, Muhammad ibn Sinan, Zakariyya ibn Adam, and Sa'd ibn Sa'd for their fidelity, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the precedent for the authority of the *Fuqaha* and the necessity of trusting the Imam's designated representatives in matters of religious and social guidance.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 303 - One of those reports is that which Abu Talib Qummi has narrated:

I came to Imam Jawad (a.s) in the last period of my life and had the honor of meeting the Imam. I heard him say: Allah, the Mighty and the High may give a good recompense on my behalf to Safwan bin Yahya, Muhammad bin Sinan, Zakariya bin Adam and Saad bin Saad; they have indeed fulfilled their covenant [of Wilayat], and Zakariya bin Adam was of those who had his Wilayat.
